uuid.title: Recurly UUID
uuid.description: The UUID is useful for matching data with the CSV exports and building URLs into Recurly's UI.

code.description: The unique identifier of the account.

email.description: The email address used for communicating with this customer.

dunning_campaign_id.title: Dunning Campaign ID
dunning_campaign_id.description: Unique ID to identify a dunning campaign. Used to specify if a non-default dunning campaign should be assigned to this account. For sites without multiple dunning campaigns enabled, the default dunning campaign will always be used.

code.title: Coupon code
code.description: The code the customer enters to redeem the coupon.

name.title: Name
name.description: The internal name for the coupon.

state.title: State
state.description: Indicates if the coupon is redeemable, and if it is not, why.

max_redemptions.title: Max redemptions
max_redemptions.description: A maximum number of redemptions for the coupon. The coupon will expire when it hits its maximum redemptions.

max_redemptions_per_account.title: Max redemptions per account
max_redemptions_per_account.description: Redemptions per account is the number of times a specific account can redeem the coupon. Set redemptions per account to `1` if you want to keep customers from gaming the system and getting more than one discount from the coupon campaign.

unique_coupon_codes_count.title: Unique coupon codes count
unique_coupon_codes_count.description: When this number reaches `max_redemptions` the coupon will no longer be redeemable.

unique_code_template.title: Unique code template
unique_code_template.description: On a bulk coupon, the template from which unique coupon codes are generated.

code.title: Coupon code
code.description: The code the customer enters to redeem the coupon.

state.title: State
state.description: Indicates if the unique coupon code is redeemable or why not.

bulk_coupon_id.title: Bulk Coupon ID
bulk_coupon_id.description: The Coupon ID of the parent Bulk Coupon

bulk_coupon_code.title: Bulk Coupon code
bulk_coupon_code.description: The Coupon code of the parent Bulk Coupon

redeemed_at.title: Redeemed at
redeemed_at.description: The date and time the unique coupon code was redeemed.

expired_at.title: Expired at
expired_at.description: The date and time the coupon was expired early or reached its `max_redemptions`.

unique_coupon_code.description: A unique coupon code for a bulk coupon.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description:
- "single_use" coupons applies to the first invoice only.
- "temporal" coupons will apply to invoices for the duration determined by the `temporal_unit` and `temporal_amount` attributes.

temporal_amount.title: Temporal amount
temporal_amount.description: If `duration` is "temporal" than `temporal_amount` is an integer which is multiplied by `temporal_unit` to define the duration that the coupon will be applied to invoices for. When `temporal_unit` is "billing_period", this is the number of complete billing cycles.

temporal_unit.title: Temporal unit
temporal_unit.description: The temporal unit for the coupon's duration. Used with temporal_amount to define how long the coupon applies. When temporal_unit is billing_period, the coupon applies for temporal_amount complete billing cycles rather than a fixed calendar duration. billing_period requires redemption_resource=subscription.

free_trial_unit.title: Free trial unit
free_trial_unit.description: Description of the unit of time the coupon is for. Used with `free_trial_amount` to determine the duration of time the coupon is for.

free_trial_amount.title: Free trial amount
free_trial_amount.description: Sets the duration of time the `free_trial_unit` is for.

applies_to_all_plans.title: Applies to all plans?
applies_to_all_plans.description: The coupon is valid for all plans if true. If false then `plans` will list the applicable plans.

applies_to_all_items.title: Applies to all items?
applies_to_all_items.description:
The coupon is valid for all items if true. If false then `items`
will list the applicable items.

applies_to_non_plan_charges.title: Applied to all non-plan charges?
applies_to_non_plan_charges.description: The coupon is valid for one-time, non-plan charges if true.

code.title: Plan code
code.description: Unique code to identify the plan. This is used in Hosted Payment Page URLs and in the invoice exports.

name.title: Name
name.description: This name describes your plan and will appear on the Hosted Payment Page and the subscriber's invoice.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: A list of plans for which this coupon applies. This will be `null` if `applies_to_all_plans=true`.

code.title: Item code
code.description: Unique code to identify the item.

state.title: State
state.description: The current state of the item.

name.title: Name
name.description: This name describes your item and will appear on the invoice when it's purchased on a one time basis.

items.title: Items
items.description:
A list of items for which this coupon applies. This will be
`null` if `applies_to_all_items=true`.

redemption_resource.title: Redemption resource
redemption_resource.description: Whether the discount is for all eligible charges on the account, or only a specific subscription.

amount.title: Discount Amount
amount.description: Value of the fixed discount that this coupon applies.

unit.title: Trial unit
unit.description: Temporal unit of the free trial. When `billing_period`, `length` represents the number of billing cycles.

length.title: Trial length
length.description: Trial length measured in the units specified by the sibling `unit` property

discount.description:
Details of the discount a coupon applies. Will contain a `type`
property and one of the following properties: `percent`, `fixed`, `trial`.

coupon_type.title: Coupon type (TODO: implement coupon generation)
coupon_type.description: Whether the coupon is "single_code" or "bulk". Bulk coupons will require a `unique_code_template` and will generate unique codes through the `/generate` endpoint.

hosted_page_description.title: Hosted Payment Pages description
hosted_page_description.description: This description will show up when a customer redeems a coupon on your Hosted Payment Pages, or if you choose to show the description on your own checkout page.

invoice_description.title: Invoice description
invoice_description.description: Description of the coupon on the invoice.

redeem_by.title: Redeem by
redeem_by.description: The date and time the coupon will expire and can no longer be redeemed. Time is always 11:59:59, the end-of-day Pacific time.

expired_at.title: Expired at
expired_at.description: The date and time the coupon was expired early or reached its `max_redemptions`.

type.title: Duration Type
type.description: The coupon's duration type. `temporal` includes an `expires_at` timestamp. `billing_periods` includes a `redemptions_remaining` count of billing cycles. `forever` and `single_use` have no additional fields.

expires_at.title: Expires at
expires_at.description: Present when `type` is `temporal`. The datetime after which this redemption will no longer apply.

redemptions_remaining.title: Redemptions Remaining
redemptions_remaining.description: The number of redemption periods remaining for which this coupon will still apply.

discounted.title: Amount Discounted
discounted.description: The amount that was discounted upon the application of the coupon, formatted with the currency.

removed_at.title: Removed at
removed_at.description: The date and time the redemption was removed from the account (un-redeemed).
